nodes.label: stations_series.py
nodes.detail: Streams the CTD extract one cast at a time. saw.said on ARCHIVE.md: The null is computed, not assumed, and the naive one is wrong. Marginally, minima do *not* fall with visit count: median annual minimum is 4.73 mg/l at 3 visits and 6.30 at 12. A null of "severity rises with count" would be inverted by the window effect. Within the 2,314 fixed units, drawing month-sets from each station-year's own twelve values (200 Monte Carlo draws): | indicator on the same 2,314 station-years | mean min (mg/l) | P(min < 4) | |---|---|---| | min over all 12 months | 5.69 | 0.250 | | Emin over [3 months drawn at random] | 7.23 | 0.058 | | min over the fixed window {Jul, Aug, Sep} | 5.93 | 0.219 | Count alone moves exceedance by 4.3×; fixing the window to Jul–Sep recovers almost all of the 12-month signal from 3 draws. That table *is* the null: the per-station-year resampling distribution of the indicator, against which any observed path is scored.
